WITH RECURSIVE MENU_INFO AS ( SELECT M.MENU_ID , M.MENU_NAME , M.MENU_TYPE , M.URL , M.PARENT_MENU_ID , M.SORT_ORDER FROM TB_MENU M INNER JOIN TB_MENU_AUTHORITY MA ON M.MENU_ID = MA.MENU_ID WHERE MA.AUTHORITY_CODE IN
#{authority}
AND M.DATA_STATUS = 'ENABLED'
UNION
SELECT P.MENU_ID , P.MENU_NAME , P.MENU_TYPE , P.URL , P.PARENT_MENU_ID , P.SORT_ORDER FROM TB_MENU P INNER JOIN MENU_INFO C ON P.MENU_ID = C.PARENT_MENU_ID WHERE P.DATA_STATUS = 'ENABLED' ) SELECT DISTINCT MENU_ID , MENU_NAME , MENU_TYPE , URL , PARENT_MENU_ID , SORT_ORDER FROM MENU_INFO ORDER BY SORT_ORDER
